package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type DiagnosticBootstrapStarter interface {
	Start(context.Context, string, string, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestV1) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapResultV1, bool, error)
}

type DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapHandler struct{ Bootstrap DiagnosticBootstrapStarter }

func (h DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapHandler) Start(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	actor, ok := middleware.ActorFromContext(r.Context())
	rawActorID := r.Header.Get("X-User-ID")
	media, _, mediaErr := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	key := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
	parsed, keyErr := uuid.Parse(key)
	if !ok || rawActorID != actor.UserID || !isCanonicalBootstrapUUID(rawActorID) {
		writeBootstrapError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden")
		return
	}
	if mediaErr != nil || media != "application/json" || keyErr != nil || parsed.String() != key {
		writeBootstrapError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "malformed_request")
		return
	}
	var input domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestV1
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 16<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&input); err != nil || decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		writeBootstrapError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "malformed_request")
		return
	}
	result, created, err := h.Bootstrap.Start(r.Context(), actor.UserID, key, input)
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			writeBootstrapError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
			writeBootstrapError(w, http.StatusConflict, "idempotency_conflict")
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			writeBootstrapError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found")
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable):
			writeBootstrapError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "upstream_unavailable")
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid):
			writeBootstrapError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "upstream_invalid")
		default:
			writeBootstrapError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error")
		}
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusOK
	if created {
		status = http.StatusCreated
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

func isCanonicalBootstrapUUID(raw string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(raw)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == raw
}
func writeBootstrapError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}
